supabaseSystemSchemas: auth/storage minimal fixtures; hosted services not tested
checks: RLS enabled on every application table
signup trigger creates profile without metadata privilege escalation
member sees own personal records only
all browser business writes explicitly closed
center administrator cannot read another center member records
trusted server has explicit private billing access
published catalog image readable without exposing orphan uploads
retired product and image disappear from public catalog
buyer retains retired product title in membership history
unrelated member sees no private purchases
payment cannot name a different member than its subscription
payment cannot use another center configuration
subscription price belongs to its product
locker cannot have duplicate current assignments
attendance derives Korean date from timestamp
attendance subscription must belong to member
rerun stops without changing existing data
user-facing verification SQL reports all PASS
pre-existing table preserved and installation remains atomic
